comments.text: Hi Tim, I think you could understand the question in both ways. The question actually asks whether sports stars ARE good role models, and maybe I should have answered that more directly first e.g. "Some sports stars are very good role models, but others aren't. In my opinion, they SHOULD be good role models because children look up to them..."
